newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Seafresh says first qtr ahead of budget.
newsitem.headline: Seafresh says first qtr ahead of budget.

text.p: Seafresh New Zealand Ltd said on Wednesday that sales and profit were exceeding budget in the first quarter.
"Initial results for the first quarter are promising," Seafresh chairman Graham France told the annual meeting.
"As you know, this period is very much the slack time for fishing companies, but nevertheless both sales and profit exceed budget," he said.
"Recent acquisitions to the fleet, increases in the quota portfolio and additions to the factory, have added to the balance sheet," he said.
"However, perhaps most important, in terms of the real value of the enterprise, has been the scope added to the company through the expansion of its international business relationships."

France said the company now had three joint venture arrangements with Chinese companies and one with a Malaysian company. Seafresh was using these Asian connections to become truly international in its outlook and expected to develop the
international relationship from being currently production-oriented to taking in a stronger international market perspective.
